notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content:
Solitary Horizons Demo is now avaliable for everyone. Discover the region “Grassland Glade” of PEARL-34. 

The demo will contain the following missions:
[b]
RESUPPLY:[/b]

You'll need to resupply, both for yourself and your spacecraft.


[b]A CLEAR CONNECTION:[/b]

In A Clear Connection, you'll have to defend your station as your robots build and set it up around PEARL-34.

You're not just constructing, you're holding the line. Hostile forces won't wait for your systems to come online.


[b]MINING EXPEDITION:[/b]

You'll need to gather vital crafting stones and metallum, they're your lifeline out here.

Whether you're repairing gear, powering up systems, or just staying alive, these rare resources aren't optional. They're everything.


[b]DATA RECOVERY: [/b]

You’ll need to download the data from your Xenostation, and defend it while the transfer runs.

Once it starts, you're a target. The signal draws attention, and not the friendly kind.

notes.title: Demo Releasing Soon!
notes.content:
Solitary Horizons is kicking off with a free demo! Your first shot at surviving the desolate beauty of planet PEARL-34. Alone but not helpless, you’ll scavenge, build, fight, and explore a hostile open world with only your tools and a few robotic companions by your side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155493/63889c8135f425706b0fc4b89066f05e812d1e5c.png[/img]

In the DEMO of Solitary Horizons, you'll explore the Grassland Glade region of PEARL-34, a land shaped by a harsh, though survivable, climate. Expect sweeping winds, sun-bleached plains, and the quiet hum of solitude that lingers just beneath the surface.

[b]The demo will contain the following missions:[/b]

[u]RESUPPLY: [/u]

You'll need to resupply, both for yourself and your spacecraft.


[u]A CLEAR CONNECTION: [/u]

In A Clear Connection, you'll have to defend your station as your robots build and set it up around PEARL-34.

You're not just constructing, you're holding the line. Hostile forces won't wait for your systems to come online.


[u]MINING EXPEDITION: [/u]

You'll need to gather vital crafting stones and metallum, they're your lifeline out here.

Whether you're repairing gear, powering up systems, or just staying alive, these rare resources aren't optional. They're everything.


[u]DATA RECOVERY: [/u]

You’ll need to download the data from your Xenostation, and defend it while the transfer runs.

Once it starts, you're a target. The signal draws attention, and not the friendly kind.




"[i]The universe awaits your decision; the world is yours to explore.[/i]" - [b]The Blue Bot[/b]

notes.title: Avaliable for wishlist: Solitary Horizons!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Rookie![/b]

There is almost a release date for "Solitary Horizons"! (Former known as 'Solitary'). 

Prepare to descend onto the enigmatic surface of PEARL-34, a planet completely untouched by human exploration - or so you would think. 

PEARL-34 is a place filled with beautiful nature, mysterious flora, unexplored landscapes and unique creatures. 

But beware: PEARL-34 is not that peaceful, as you might think. Unknown and technology-based creatures live on this planet. They'll do anything to stop you from surviving. 

You'll have to gather vital resources, craft and upgrade gear to endure the environments on PEARL-34.




Stay tuned, Rookie - Solitary Horizons awaits your arrival.


Sincerely,

[i]The Crew on SPC-35,862[/i]
